description: Return the daily FX snapshot re-based to `base`: every supported currency quoted as units per 1 unit of `base`, with `base` itself at 1. Use when the user wants a multi-currency table in a non-USD base (for example "rates in EUR"). Use `get_rates` for the USD table, `convert` for one pair or amount, and `get_history` for a time series. Omitting `date` returns the latest available snapshot, which is not necessarily today. Returns `{ base, date, rates }`; an unsupported base or a date with no snapshot is a 404. Requires a signed-in connection; each successful call bills 1 API request.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest available date.

name: get_rates_by_base
title: Exchange rates by base currency
